text:
Ana C.: Vendor pentest confirmed for 2026-08-16 -> 2026-08-18 against staging in VPC. Special constraints: HSM-backed KMS (customer-managed HSM), no public endpoints, private peering only. Need HSM access policy + evidence export workflow, RBAC freeze, log capture plan, redaction sign-off, and a single remediation+retest tracker. Who can own what?

Ben I.: I can own KMS/HSM side and presigned upload flow. We will NOT give raw HSM access. Plan: rewrap evidence with a test key backed by HSM, then presign PUTs to an encrypted bucket. TTL 7200s by default.

Ben I.: Quick CLI example for rewrap/encrypt step:
```
aws kms encrypt --key-id alias/pt-rewrap --plaintext fileb://evidence.tgz --encryption-context purpose=pt-evidence --output text --query CiphertextBlob | base64 --decode > evidence.enc
```

Carlos S.: I'll take network/log capture. Enable VPC Flow Logs for affected subnets, and run packet capture (pcap) mirroring for 15m at test start. Also export CloudTrail + KMS usage logs. Will run automated scrub and post results.

Deepa P.: RBAC plan: ephemeral cross-account role `pt_assessor_<vendor>` assumed with external-id and MFA. Attach session policy that is read-only and explicitly denies any `iam:*`, `kms:Create*`, `ec2:RunInstances`, etc. No permanent policy branching. Revoke role 24h after window.

Ana C.: Legal note (legal-bot): redact PII, user identifiers, and any internal tokens before handing logs off. Need sign-off from Legal before external transfer. Record HSM key usage report and include it in the evidence bundle.

Evan: I'll own the remediation tracker and retest coordination. Will create a GH project board with columns: triage, in-progress, awaiting-evidence, ready-for-retest, retested. Proposed retest weeks: 2026-08-23 or 2026-08-30. I'll send invite.

ops-bot: VPC snapshot created: vpc-snap-341234-20260815 (id: vpc-snap-341234).

Ben I.: Conceptual HSM/KMS policy snippet to enforce encryption-context and via-service check (will refine for prod):
`{"Effect":"Allow","Action":["kms:Encrypt","kms:Decrypt"],"Resource":"arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456:key/pt-hsm-key","Condition":{"StringEquals":{"kms:EncryptionContext:purpose":"pt-evidence","kms:ViaService":"cloudhsm.amazonaws.com"}}}`

Deepa P.: No direct SSH. If vendor requests shell, grant recorded jumpbox session only (session recordings stored to audit bucket). Also require session tag `pt:vendor=<vendor>` on assumptions.

Ana C.: Assignments recap: Ben -> HSM policy & presign docs; Carlos -> network captures + scrub report; Deepa -> RBAC runbook + teardown; Evan -> remediation tracker + retest calendar; Ana -> publish ops checklist and legal handoff doc. Everyone add availability to the invite. Ping here with blockers.

Ben I.: One small ask: vendors must include metadata header `x-amz-meta-purpose: pt-evidence` on uploads so we can enforce via encryption context.

Carlos S.: Will run `log-scrub --preview SECRET,API_KEY,USER_ID` on exported logs and post findings. If scrub flags anything, we'll do manual redaction and record reviewer.

Ana C.: Thanks all. Remember: if an active exploit is observed, pause the test immediately and escalate to oncall and security-lead.
